name: Bresal

attributes.attribute: a given name held among the early Irish
the name of several kings of the land

text: Bresal was a name carried by many of the early Irish. A string of the kings of the land bore the name. More than one of the myth made it plain. The letters of the old record name a saint of the church who took the same name as well. So the single word Bresal touches more than one life across the span of the early books.

okr.objective: Name the uses of the word Bresal among the early Irish.
key_results: The name Bresal was carried by the early Irish.
Many of the kings of the land took it.
A saint of the isle bore the name too.
